scenarios.text_scenario: You are cooking and suddenly remember you must call someone back this evening.
examples: Shaam ko wapas baat karni hai, yaad rakhna
Bhoolna mat, phone karna hai use
Note kar lo shaam wala kaam

scenarios.text_scenario: A bill payment is due at the end of the week and you keep forgetting it.
examples: Hafte ke aakhir mein bill wala yaad dilana
Har baar bhool jata hoon, tok dena
Shukrawar ko batana mujhe

scenarios.text_scenario: You are lying in bed and realise you have an early appointment.
examples: Kal jaldi jaana hai, uthana mujhe
Subah sawere jaga dena
Der na ho jaye, jaga dena zaroor

scenarios.text_scenario: You want a second backup alarm because you usually sleep through the first.
examples: Ek aur laga do, pehle wala kaam nahi karta
Backup wala bhi set karo
Do baar bajana mujhe

scenarios.text_scenario: Guests are coming over and you want something pleasant playing in the background.
examples: Mehmaan aa rahe, halka sa lagao
Background mein kuch dheema chalao
Mahaul ke liye kuch lagao

scenarios.text_scenario: You are exercising and want something with energy.
examples: Kasrat kar raha hoon, tez wala lagao
Josh wala kuch bajao
Energy wala gaana daalo

scenarios.text_scenario: You are already driving and the road ahead splits in two directions.
examples: Do raste hain, kaunsa lena hai?
Aage kidhar mudna hai batao
Rasta dikhate raho chalte chalte

scenarios.text_scenario: There is heavy traffic and you want a different route.
examples: Jam laga hai, dusra rasta batao
Is bhid se bachne ka koi tarika?
Alag se le chalo mujhe

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to dry clothes outside and need to know if it will stay dry.
examples: Kapde bahar sukha sakte hain aaj?
Paani girega to nahi din mein?
Bahar sukhane layak hai mausam?

scenarios.text_scenario: You are planning a picnic this weekend and want to know conditions.
examples: Hafte ke aakhir mein kaisa rahega?
Bahar jaane layak hoga ya nahi?
Picnic ke liye theek rahega mausam?

scenarios.text_scenario: You are driving and need to reach someone without touching the phone.
examples: Gaadi chala raha hoon, laga do unhe
Haath nahi laga sakta, jod do baat
Bina chhue milao number

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to return a missed call you just noticed.
examples: Missed call aayi thi, wapas milao
Jinka call aaya tha, unhe lagao
Chhuti hui call wapas karo

scenarios.text_scenario: You are in a meeting and cannot talk, so you want to text instead.
examples: Meeting mein hoon, likh ke bhej do
Baat nahi kar sakta, likh do
Chupchap ek sandesh bhejo

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to wish someone for a festival or birthday.
examples: Badhai wala sandesh bhej do
Tyohar ki shubhkamna likh do
Janamdin ki badhai bhejo unhe

scenarios.text_scenario: You are watching something and want to know more about a person mentioned.
examples: Ye kaun hai, dhundo iske baare mein
Inke baare mein jaankari nikalo
Iska itihas kya hai, pata karo

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to know how to do something practical at home.
examples: Ye kaise banate hain, dekho
Iska tarika dhundo mujhe
Ghar pe kaise karte hain ye?

scenarios.text_scenario: You put something on the stove that must not be left too long.
examples: Gas pe chadha hai, samay gino
Zyada der na ho, ginti chalao
Utna samay naap lo iske liye

scenarios.text_scenario: You are taking a short rest and want to be alerted when it ends.
examples: Thodi der aaram karunga, jaga dena
Utne samay baad awaz karna
Chhoti si jhapki ka samay laga do

scenarios.text_scenario: Someone else in the room is sleeping and the screen is too bright.
examples: Koi so raha hai, roshni kam karo
Screen dheemi kar do thodi
Andhera sa kar do yahan

scenarios.text_scenario: The room has become too warm and you want the fan or AC adjusted.
examples: Garmi lag rahi, thanda karo
Hawa tez kar do zara
Temperature kam karo kamre ka

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker makes conversation or expresses a feeling, with no command at all.
examples: Bahut boring din tha aaj
Tumse baat karke acha laga
Pata nahi kya karu samajh nahi aa raha

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker asks something from another domain — banking, education, or travel.
examples: Kiraya bhej do makan malik ko
Is sawaal ka hal batao
Raat wali gaadi mein jagah hai?

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker mutters, laughs, or trails off without any request.
examples: Arre nahi nahi
Hmm dekhte hain
Kuch nahi bas aise hi
